cmd:
echo ===DATE===; date -u
echo ===CRONTAB===; sudo crontab -l
echo ===LOCKS===; ls -la /tmp/vps_pipeline.lock /tmp/vps_satellite_pipeline.lock /tmp/vps_ai_pipeline.lock 2>&1
echo ===PS===; ps aux | grep -E "vps_(pipeline|satellite_pipeline|ai_pipeline).py" | grep -v grep
echo ===GIT-STATUS===; cd /opt/weather-pipeline/repo && git status
echo ===GIT-LOG===; git log -3 --oneline
echo ===GIT-REMOTE===; git remote -v
echo ===TAIL-MAIN===; tail -40 /var/log/vps-pipeline.log
echo ===TAIL-SAT===; tail -60 /var/log/vps-satellite-pipeline.log
echo ===TAIL-AI===; tail -30 /var/log/vps-ai-pipeline.log
